sentences.text:
The present appeal is filed by the appellant/KSRTC challenging the judgment and award dated 02.05.2012 in MVC.No.378/2010 passed by the District Judge & Member, MACT, Chamarajanagar,
as the quantum of compensation granted by the Tribunal is excessive one.
2. The factum of accident is not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.

In the present case, the Tribunal has granted compensation of Rs.50,000/- under the head injury,
pain and suffering, Rs.10,261/- under the head medical expenses, treatment, conveyance,
nourishment, diet, transport and other incidental charges, Rs.65,000/- under the head disability and loss of future income and NC: 2023:KHC:21015 loss of future prospects of life and unhappiness and Rs.15,000/- under the head loss of future amenities and loss of future enjoyment of life and unhappiness.
5. From the evidence on record, it is proved that the claimant had suffered fracture of humorous of right hand.
Hence, the compensation awarded under the head injury, pain and suffering is on the higher side.
Therefore, it is reduced to Rs.25,000/- from Rs.50,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.

6. Further the Tribunal without having any calculation has awarded compensation of Rs.65,000/-
under the head disability and loss of future income and loss of future prospects of life and unhappiness.

Therefore, considering the medical evidence on record, compensation of Rs.50,000/-
is awarded under the head disability and loss of future income and loss of future prospects of life and unhappiness as against Rs.65,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
The amount of compensation awarded under other heads is found to be just and proper.
8. Thus, in all, the claimant is entitled to total compensation under various heads as follows:

9 . Therefore, the claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.1,00,261/- as against Rs.1,40,261/-
awarded by the Tribunal.

Hence, the claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.1,00,261/-
along with interest NC: 2023:KHC:21015 at the rate of 6% p.a., from the date of petition till realization.

10. Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i.
The appeal filed by the appellant-KSRTC is allowed.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 02.05.2012 in MVC.No.378/2010 passed by the District Judge & Member, MACT, Chamarajanagar, is modified to the extent that the appellant/claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.1,00,261/-
as against Rs.1,40,261/- awarded by the Tribunal along with interest at the rate of 6%
p.a., from the date of petition till realization.
iii. No order as to costs.
The amount in deposit made by the appellant- KSRTC shall be transmitted to the Tribunal forthwith.
